jp: \t\tかつて世界征服を目論んだ秘密組織によって開発された。高性能な潜入用アイテムであり、当時の世界中のあらゆる組織の制服に自在に変化する。現在はわずかに発掘されたものが職人の手で修復されて残っている程度。ナノマシン制御装置の劣化などにより、変化できる形態がとても少なくなっている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tかつて世界征服を目論んだ秘密組織によって開発された。高性能な潜入用アイテムであり、当時の世界中のあらゆる組織の制服に自在に変化する。現在はわずかに発掘されたものが職人の手で修復されて残っている程度。ナノマシン制御装置の劣化などにより、変化できる形態がとても少なくなっている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: It was developed by a secret organization that once planned to conquer the world. It was a high-performance infiltration item that could be transformed at will into the uniforms of any organization in the world at that time. Currently, there are only a few of these items that have been excavated and restored by craftsmen. Due to the deterioration of the nanomachine control device, the number of forms that can be changed is very limited. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "It was developed by a secret organization that once planned to conquer the world. It was a high-performance infiltration item that could be transformed at will into the uniforms of any organization in the world at that time. Currently, there are only a few of these items that have been excavated and restored by craftsmen. Due to the deterioration of the nanomachine control device, the number of forms that can be changed is very limited. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Lo sviluppò un'organizzazione segreta che un tempo puntava alla conquista del mondo. È un oggetto d'infiltrazione ad alte prestazioni, e si trasforma a piacere nell'uniforme di qualunque organizzazione ci fosse allora al mondo. Oggi ne restano sì e no i pochi esemplari dissotterrati e rimessi in sesto da qualche artigiano. Col decadere del regolatore a nanomacchine, le forme che riesce a prendere si sono fatte pochissime. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t魔法アイテム発明家の作品。竹鎧を使いこなしている騎士を見て、竹の可能性に気付いたとのこと。一から設計を行い、上質な竹を割って作り、高級塗料でコーティングし、魔法で何度も強化したそれは、防具を超えた一級芸術品となった。後に、アイディアをくれた騎士に進呈しようとしたところ、なぜか複雑そうな笑顔を浮かべて丁重にお断りされたという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔法アイテム発明家の作品。竹鎧を使いこなしている騎士を見て、竹の可能性に気付いたとのこと。一から設計を行い、上質な竹を割って作り、高級塗料でコーティングし、魔法で何度も強化したそれは、防具を超えた一級芸術品となった。後に、アイディアをくれた騎士に進呈しようとしたところ、なぜか複雑そうな笑顔を浮かべて丁重にお断りされたという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Work of a magic item inventor. He realized the potential of bamboo when he saw a knight using bamboo armor. After designing it from scratch, splitting fine bamboo, coating it with high-grade paints, and reinforcing it repeatedly with magic, it became a first-class work of art that transcended armor. When he later tried to present it to the knight who gave him the idea, he was politely turned down with a complicated smile on his face for some reason. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Work of a magic item inventor. He realized the potential of bamboo when he saw a knight using bamboo armor. After designing it from scratch, splitting fine bamboo, coating it with high-grade paints, and reinforcing it repeatedly with magic, it became a first-class work of art that transcended armor. When he later tried to present it to the knight who gave him the idea, he was politely turned down with a complicated smile on his face for some reason. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: L'opera di un inventore di oggetti magici. Pare che, vedendo un cavaliere che maneggiava bene un'armatura di bambù, si sia accorto di quel che il bambù poteva dare. Progettata da zero, ricavata spaccando bambù di prima qualità, rivestita di vernice pregiata e rinforzata con la magia più e più volte, è diventata un'opera d'arte di primo rango, ben oltre un'armatura. Più tardi la volle regalare al cavaliere che gli aveva dato l'idea, e si dice che quello, con un sorriso difficile da spiegare, l'abbia rifiutata con garbo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tゴーレムが暴走した時のための保険。主人の合図ひとつでベルトが締まり対象を抑え込める。さらに、過剰な魔力を放出させる機能も備わっている。主人からの唯一の贈り物だったため、宝物のように大事にされ泥もほとんどついていない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tゴーレムが暴走した時のための保険。主人の合図ひとつでベルトが締まり対象を抑え込める。さらに、過剰な魔力を放出させる機能も備わっている。主人からの唯一の贈り物だったため、宝物のように大事にされ泥もほとんどついていない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Insurance in case of a golem rampage. With a single signal from the master, the belt can be tightened to restrain the target. It also has a function to release excess magic power. Since it was the only gift from the master, it is cherished like a treasure and has almost no dirt on it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Insurance in case of a golem rampage. With a single signal from the master, the belt can be tightened to restrain the target. It also has a function to release excess magic power. Since it was the only gift from the master, it is cherished like a treasure and has almost no dirt on it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una garanzia per quando il golem va fuori controllo. A un solo cenno del padrone le cinghie si stringono e tengono fermo chi le porta. E c'è anche di che sfogare il potere magico in eccesso. Siccome era l'unico regalo che il padrone le avesse fatto, è tenuta da conto come un tesoro, e di fango non ne ha quasi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tメイルーン王家に伝わる大鎧。かつて名工が献上したものの一つ。徹底的な寒さ対策が施されてるにも関わらず、一部を開放することで暑地でも充分着用可能。民間で見様見真似で作り上げた模倣品が防寒具として一昔前に重宝されていたが、近年では無骨なデザインがお洒落でないと不評、廃れている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tメイルーン王家に伝わる大鎧。かつて名工が献上したものの一つ。徹底的な寒さ対策が施されてるにも関わらず、一部を開放することで暑地でも充分着用可能。民間で見様見真似で作り上げた模倣品が防寒具として一昔前に重宝されていたが、近年では無骨なデザインがお洒落でないと不評、廃れている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Great armor passed down through the Mayroon royal family. It is one of the items once presented by a master craftsman. Despite its thorough protection against cold, it can be worn even in hot climates by opening some parts. Imitations made by the common folk were useful as winter protection a long time ago, but in recent years, the rugged design has fallen into disrepute as unfashionable and has fallen into disuse.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Great armor passed down through the Mayroon royal family. It is one of the items once presented by a master craftsman. Despite its thorough protection against cold, it can be worn even in hot climates by opening some parts. Imitations made by the common folk were useful as winter protection a long time ago, but in recent years, the rugged design has fallen into disrepute as unfashionable and has fallen into disuse.\n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una grande corazza che si tramanda nella casa reale di Mayroon, una di quelle che a suo tempo donò un maestro artigiano. Benché sia pensata da cima a fondo contro il freddo, aprendone qualche parte la si può portare benissimo anche nei paesi caldi. Le imitazioni che la gente comune costruiva a occhio erano assai apprezzate come riparo dal freddo fino a una generazione fa; di questi tempi però la linea rozza non piace più, la dicono fuori moda, e sta sparendo.\n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t材料をケチった結果、バリアコーティング処理に失敗。軽く引っ掻いただけで表面がボロボロ崩れるほどにまで劣化している。色落ちしているのも表面剥離が原因。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t材料をケチった結果、バリアコーティング処理に失敗。軽く引っ掻いただけで表面がボロボロ崩れるほどにまで劣化している。色落ちしているのも表面剥離が原因。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: As a result of being stingy with materials, the barrier coating treatment failed. The surface has deteriorated to the point that it crumbles to pieces when lightly scratched. The color fading is also caused by the surface peeling. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "As a result of being stingy with materials, the barrier coating treatment failed. The surface has deteriorated to the point that it crumbles to pieces when lightly scratched. The color fading is also caused by the surface peeling. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: A furia di risparmiare sui materiali, il rivestimento a barriera è venuto male. Si è degradato al punto che basta un graffio leggero perché la superficie si sbricioli. Anche il colore se n'è andato, e la causa è la stessa: la superficie che si sfoglia. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tバリアコーティング処理により、従来とは比べ物にならない軽さと防御性能を併せ持つスーツ。製造コストの問題により正式採用はされず、試作品さえ作りかけの状態で倉庫に収納されていた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tバリアコーティング処理により、従来とは比べ物にならない軽さと防御性能を併せ持つスーツ。製造コストの問題により正式採用はされず、試作品さえ作りかけの状態で倉庫に収納されていた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The barrier coating process gives this suit unparalleled lightness and defensive performance. Due to manufacturing cost issues, it was not officially adopted, and even the prototype was stored in a warehouse in an unfinished state. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The barrier coating process gives this suit unparalleled lightness and defensive performance. Due to manufacturing cost issues, it was not officially adopted, and even the prototype was stored in a warehouse in an unfinished state. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una tuta che, grazie al rivestimento a barriera, mette insieme una leggerezza e una difesa che con quelle di prima non si possono nemmeno paragonare. Per via di quanto costava produrla non fu mai adottata davvero, e perfino il prototipo restò in magazzino a metà. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t機械の神が己の力を抑え込むために纏っている拘束具。脱いだらスゴイことになる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機械の神が己の力を抑え込むために纏っている拘束具。脱いだらスゴイことになる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Restraints worn by the God of Machine to suppress his power. It looks cool when taken off. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Restraints worn by the God of Machine to suppress his power. It looks cool when taken off. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il vincolo che il dio delle macchine si porta addosso per tenere a freno la propria forza. A toglierselo, succedono cose grosse. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t本来は首から下全てを覆うスーツだったのだが、予想以上にコストがかさんだため途中で開発が中止され胴体部分しか作られなかった。そのため一見ただの水着にしか見えない。表面はバリアコーティングされておりそれなりの防御性能を持つ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t本来は首から下全てを覆うスーツだったのだが、予想以上にコストがかさんだため途中で開発が中止され胴体部分しか作られなかった。そのため一見ただの水着にしか見えない。表面はバリアコーティングされておりそれなりの防御性能を持つ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Originally, the suit was to cover the entire body from the neck down, but development was halted midway due to higher-than-expected costs, and only the torso portion was made. Therefore, at first glance, it appears to be nothing more than a swimsuit. The surface of the suit is coated with a barrier coating to provide a certain level of protection. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Originally, the suit was to cover the entire body from the neck down, but development was halted midway due to higher-than-expected costs, and only the torso portion was made. Therefore, at first glance, it appears to be nothing more than a swimsuit. The surface of the suit is coated with a barrier coating to provide a certain level of protection. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: In origine doveva essere una tuta che copriva tutto dal collo in giù, ma i costi sono cresciuti più del previsto, lo sviluppo si è fermato a metà strada e ne è stata fatta solo la parte del busto. Per questo a prima vista non sembra altro che un costume da bagno. La superficie ha il rivestimento a barriera, e una sua difesa ce l'ha. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t服の中に多数の素材片を埋め込み強化を図った防具。イェルスの民には日常的にこの服を着ている変わり者もいるらしい。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t服の中に多数の素材片を埋め込み強化を図った防具。イェルスの民には日常的にこの服を着ている変わり者もいるらしい。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This armor is reinforced by embedding numerous pieces of material into the clothing. Some of the people of Yerles people are said to be eccentric enough to wear these clothes on a daily basis. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This armor is reinforced by embedding numerous pieces of material into the clothing. Some of the people of Yerles people are said to be eccentric enough to wear these clothes on a daily basis. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'armatura rinforzata infilando molti pezzetti di materiale dentro il vestito. Pare che fra la gente di Yerles ci sia qualche tipo strano che lo porta tutti i giorni. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t胴に板状の素材をくくりつけた防具。素材そのままを使っている為、使う種類が性能に直結しているが、それは即ち重量もそれに直結しているということなので素材選びには十分注意しよう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t胴に板状の素材をくくりつけた防具。素材そのままを使っている為、使う種類が性能に直結しているが、それは即ち重量もそれに直結しているということなので素材選びには十分注意しよう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Armor made by attaching a plate-like material to the torso. Since the material is used as it is, the type of material used is directly related to its performance, which in turn is directly related to its weight, so be careful when selecting the material. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Armor made by attaching a plate-like material to the torso. Since the material is used as it is, the type of material used is directly related to its performance, which in turn is directly related to its weight, so be careful when selecting the material. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'armatura fatta legando al busto del materiale a forma di piastra. Siccome il materiale si usa così com'è, la qualità che si sceglie va dritta nelle prestazioni; ma allora ci va dritto anche il peso, e nello scegliere conviene stare bene attenti. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t服の中に素材片を埋め込み強化を図った防具。一見すると通常の服に見える為、洒落た冒険者が装備していることがままある。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t服の中に素材片を埋め込み強化を図った防具。一見すると通常の服に見える為、洒落た冒険者が装備していることがままある。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Armor that has been reinforced by embedding pieces of material into the clothing. At first glance, it looks like ordinary clothing, so it is often worn by fashionable adventurers. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Armor that has been reinforced by embedding pieces of material into the clothing. At first glance, it looks like ordinary clothing, so it is often worn by fashionable adventurers. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'armatura rinforzata infilando pezzetti di materiale dentro il vestito. Siccome a prima vista sembra un vestito qualunque, capita spesso che se lo mettano gli avventurieri eleganti. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t特定の部位にのみ金属を張り付けた鎧。軽い為に素早く、かつ柔軟に動くことができるが頑強さは失われている。厚鎧とどちらを取るかは冒険者の好みと言ったところだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特定の部位にのみ金属を張り付けた鎧。軽い為に素早く、かつ柔軟に動くことができるが頑強さは失われている。厚鎧とどちらを取るかは冒険者の好みと言ったところだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Armor with metal attached only to specific parts of it. It is lightweight, allowing for quick and flexible movement, but it is not as strong as standard armor. It is up to the adventurer to choose between this and standard thick armor.\n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Armor with metal attached only to specific parts of it. It is lightweight, allowing for quick and flexible movement, but it is not as strong as standard armor. It is up to the adventurer to choose between this and standard thick armor.\n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una corazza che ha il metallo attaccato solo in certi punti. Essendo leggera lascia muoversi svelti e sciolti, ma ci si perde in robustezza. Se prendere questa o la corazza a bande, si dirà, è gusto dell'avventuriero.\n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\tより高位のものが身につける為に織られた法衣。多少重くはなったがそれでも鎧よりは軽い防具だ。様々な刺繍や特殊な織り方で整えられた結果、法衣より堅固なものとなっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tより高位のものが身につける為に織られた法衣。多少重くはなったがそれでも鎧よりは軽い防具だ。様々な刺繍や特殊な織り方で整えられた結果、法衣より堅固なものとなっている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A vestment woven to be worn by those of higher rank. They are slightly heavier, but still lighter than armor. They are more solid than vestments as a result of various embroideries and special weaving techniques. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A vestment woven to be worn by those of higher rank. They are slightly heavier, but still lighter than armor. They are more solid than vestments as a result of various embroideries and special weaving techniques. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una veste tessuta perché la porti chi sta più in alto. È un'armatura che pesa un po' di più, ma sempre meno di una corazza. A furia di ricami d'ogni sorta e di tessiture speciali, è venuta più solida di una veste comune. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t鱗のような小さな素材片を紐で繋ぎ合せて作られた鎧。その構造から柔軟である上、強固であるという特性を持つ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鱗のような小さな素材片を紐で繋ぎ合せて作られた鎧。その構造から柔軟である上、強固であるという特性を持つ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This armor is made of small scale-like pieces of material joined together with strings. Its structure makes it both flexible and strong. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This armor is made of small scale-like pieces of material joined together with strings. Its structure makes it both flexible and strong. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una corazza fatta legando con dei lacci dei pezzetti di materiale piccoli come squame. Per come è costruita è insieme flessibile e solida. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t特殊な素材をかけ合わせてより強固な防護を得た鎧。服の上からベストの様に着込むことができる利便性を持つ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特殊な素材をかけ合わせてより強固な防護を得た鎧。服の上からベストの様に着込むことができる利便性を持つ。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Armor that combines special materials to provide stronger protection. It has the convenience of being able to be worn over clothing like a vest. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Armor that combines special materials to provide stronger protection. It has the convenience of being able to be worn over clothing like a vest. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una corazza che, incrociando materiali speciali, ha ottenuto una protezione più solida. Ha il comodo di potersi infilare sopra i vestiti come un gilè. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t布でできた鎧に幾つもの輪を縫い合わせた鎧。表面上の多数の輪には、剣の一撃を弾く特性があるという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t布でできた鎧に幾つもの輪を縫い合わせた鎧。表面上の多数の輪には、剣の一撃を弾く特性があるという。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This armor is made of fabric with many rings sewn onto it. The rings on the surface of the armor are said to have the property of repelling sword blows. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This armor is made of fabric with many rings sewn onto it. The rings on the surface of the armor are said to have the property of repelling sword blows. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una corazza fatta cucendo un gran numero di anelli su una corazza di stoffa. Si dice che i molti anelli in superficie abbiano la proprietà di deviare il colpo di una spada. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t鎖帷子の上に甲冑を重ねた見るからに重そうな鎧。防御力は絶大なものがあるが、代償として相当な重量は覚悟した方がいいだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鎖帷子の上に甲冑を重ねた見るからに重そうな鎧。防御力は絶大なものがあるが、代償として相当な重量は覚悟した方がいいだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Heavy-looking armor consisting of chainmail overlaid with armor. It has great defensive power, but you should be prepared to pay a heavy price for it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Heavy-looking armor consisting of chainmail overlaid with armor. It has great defensive power, but you should be prepared to pay a heavy price for it. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una corazza che sovrappone le piastre alla cotta di maglia, e a guardarla pesa. La difesa che dà è enorme, ma in cambio conviene mettere in conto un peso considerevole. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t非常に分厚く作られた鎧。層が厚い為、並大抵の攻撃は物ともしないが、代わりに素早さが失われている。軽鎧とどちらを取るかは冒険者の好みと言ったところだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に分厚く作られた鎧。層が厚い為、並大抵の攻撃は物ともしないが、代わりに素早さが失われている。軽鎧とどちらを取るかは冒険者の好みと言ったところだろう。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: This armor is made of very thick layers. Because of its thick layers, it is impervious to most attacks, but at the cost of maneuverability. It is up to the adventurer to choose between this and lighter armor. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "This armor is made of very thick layers. Because of its thick layers, it is impervious to most attacks, but at the cost of maneuverability. It is up to the adventurer to choose between this and lighter armor. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una corazza fatta spessissima. Con quegli strati spessi un attacco normale non la scalfisce, ma in cambio ci si perde in prontezza. Se prendere questa o la corazza leggera, si dirà, è gusto dell'avventuriero. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t主に僧侶などが着用する、一枚の布に素材を編み込んだ防具。その製法故身を守るには適さないが、装着者の詠唱を妨害せず、身軽な行動を可能とさせている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t主に僧侶などが着用する、一枚の布に素材を編み込んだ防具。その製法故身を守るには適さないが、装着者の詠唱を妨害せず、身軽な行動を可能とさせている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Protective gear made of a single piece of woven cloth, worn mainly by monks and priests. Although not suitable for protection, it doesn't interfere with the wearer's chanting and allows the wearer to act with ease. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Protective gear made of a single piece of woven cloth, worn mainly by monks and priests. Although not suitable for protection, it doesn't interfere with the wearer's chanting and allows the wearer to act with ease. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'armatura fatta intrecciando il materiale in un unico pezzo di stoffa, e la portano soprattutto i monaci. Per come è fatta a difendere il corpo non serve, ma non intralcia gli incantesimi di chi la indossa e lascia muoversi leggeri. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t武器の進化に合わせて開発された防具。重量はあるが急所に致命傷を与えない役目は十分に果たしている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t武器の進化に合わせて開発された防具。重量はあるが急所に致命傷を与えない役目は十分に果たしている。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: Armor developed to match the evolution of weapons. Although it is heavy, it serves its purpose of preventing fatal injuries to vital organs. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "Armor developed to match the evolution of weapons. Although it is heavy, it serves its purpose of preventing fatal injuries to vital organs. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Un'armatura messa a punto via via che le armi si evolvevano. Il suo peso ce l'ha, ma il compito di non far arrivare un colpo mortale ai punti vitali lo assolve bene. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~
